name: Feishu Researcher Export Mirror
description: Mirror pending researcher export files into the current workspace before Feishu handoff sends and before matching read calls execute.

researcherWorkspaceRoot.description: Researcher workspace root used to resolve researcher export files (default: ~/.openclaw/workspace-researcher).

exportPrefix.description: Relative export prefix used to detect researcher export files (default: artifacts/exports/feishu).

openclawRoot.description: OpenClaw state root used to resolve agent session transcripts and requester workspaces (default: ~/.openclaw).

researcherAgentId.description: Researcher agent id whose completed subagent exports should be mirrored (default: researcher).
